current.text: Goodwin re-signed with Phoenix for 3 years and 19 million USD.
Experts call the contract a steal and undervalued.
He is expected to be in the rotation as the fourth or fifth guard.

Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks and Miles Bridges are expected to take most of the Phoenix minutes and usage, with Collin Gillespie also wanting touches. That leaves little room for a backup guard.
He is a Tier 9 point guard. He is clearly a 16-team league player and only possibly worth a look in 12-team leagues.

durable.text: His value comes mostly from steals and few turnovers. He scores little and his FG% is low.
